closed form, hand-computed on the TESTING 7.8 series, same confidence as portfolio.risk.var.linear.80 and a different percentile convention, so the pair pins that the choice is never silent: the nearest-rank 20th percentile is order statistic ceil(0.20 x 10) = 2, i.e. -1.00 % exactly, against the type-7 answer of -0.80 %. The tail at or below -1.00 % is -1.25 and -1.00, mean -1.125 %, so the expected shortfall is 1.125 % either way.

NAV 10,000,000. UST_PARALLEL_UP_100: P&L = -dv01 x shiftBp = -3,200 x 100 = -320,000 (equities and cash unaffected by construction). UST_STEEPEN_50 (short end -25bp, long end +25bp, pivot at 5Y): -(300 x -25 + 400 x 0 + 2,500 x 25 + 0 x 25) = -(-7,500 + 62,500) = -55,000.
